plans.idea: Faithful centred poster: headline and wordmark subheadline sit as one block in the optical middle of the tall column, framed by equal plum space above and below, with the legal line anchored at the foot just like the original.

Full-height type column: the text slot runs almost the entire skyscraper so the headline breaks into large one-word lines and the brand line gets room to wrap at a readable size, filling the format top to bottom instead of leaving a dead middle.

Sunset low horizon: an open, empty dusk sky fills the top third and the headline plus brand line settle into the lower half like a setting sun, with the legal tucked directly beneath as the closing line of one grouped block.
